title: Australian man leaves Edgar Mitchell's house with files

tellings.quote: house and this Australian guy I caught

plain: In 2016 an Australian man was caught leaving the Florida house of the Apollo astronaut Edgar Mitchell with files, according to the documentary filmmaker James Fox. Fox tells Michels "this Australian guy I caught" and brings it up in connection with the Wilson-Davis memo, said to be notes by a man named Eric Davis of a meeting with an admiral named Thomas Wilson. In Fox's telling, papers from Mitchell's house are part of how that memo came out.
